label: Chain of Thought
description: Break down complex problems into explicit reasoning steps to ensure logical consistency and thorough analysis

label: Brainstorming
description: Generate a wide range of creative ideas and solution options, then analyze and refine them

label: Decomposition Synthesis
description: Break down complex problems into manageable components, solve them individually, and synthesize the results

label: Systems Thinking
description: Analyze complex systems by examining feedback loops, interdependencies, and emergent behaviors

label: Socratic Dialogue
description: Explore ideas and uncover underlying assumptions through a structured process of Socratic questioning

label: Causal Inference
description: Identify causal relationships and root causes to understand the mechanisms driving observed phenomena

label: Mathematical Reasoning
description: Solve mathematical problems through step-by-step logical reasoning with verifiable calculations

label: Decision Tree
description: Construct and navigate a symbolic decision tree to evaluate choices and potential outcomes systematically

label: Finite State Machine
description: Model systems or concepts as finite state machines to analyze transitions, states, and behaviors

label: Game Theory
description: Analyze strategic interactions and decision-making processes using game theoretic models

label: Genetic Optimization
description: Iteratively evolve and refine text or solutions using genetic algorithms to maximize quality

label: Abstraction Ladder
description: Traverse up and down levels of abstraction to identify high-level patterns and concrete implementation details

label: Adversarial Reasoning
description: Conduct red-team analysis to identify vulnerabilities, challenge assumptions, and strengthen arguments

label: Constraint Satisfaction
description: Find optimal solutions that satisfy a set of competing constraints and requirements

label: Isomorphism Discovery
description: Identify and validate structural mappings between distinct domains to transfer knowledge and insights

label: Probabilistic Reasoning
description: Reason under uncertainty using Bayesian analysis to estimate probabilities and update beliefs

label: Structural Invariant Analysis
description: Identify the immutable properties and symmetries of an object or system to understand its core essence

label: Temporal Reasoning
description: Analyze how systems evolve over time, modeling sequences, durations, and future states

label: Abductive Reasoning
description: Generate and evaluate the most likely explanatory hypotheses for observed facts or surprising evidence

label: Analogical Reasoning
description: Solve novel problems by drawing parallels and transferring solutions from analogous domains

label: Constraint Relaxation
description: Find acceptable solutions to over-constrained problems by systematically relaxing less critical requirements

label: Counterfactual Analysis
description: Explore 'what-if' scenarios to understand causal relationships and the impact of alternative decisions

label: Dialectical Reasoning
description: Resolve contradictions and synthesize opposing viewpoints through a thesis-antithesis-synthesis process

label: Ethical Reasoning
description: Analyze complex dilemmas using established ethical frameworks to determine the most moral course of action

label: Functorial Mapping
description: Translate problems and solutions between different mathematical or conceptual domains using Category Theory

label: Iterative Graph Gen
description: Construct comprehensive knowledge graphs by iteratively expanding nodes and relationships

label: Lateral Thinking
description: Break conventional thinking patterns to generate innovative solutions and novel perspectives

label: Meta-Cognitive Reflection
description: Reflect on, critique, and optimize the reasoning process itself to improve decision quality

label: Multi-Perspective Analysis
description: Analyze problems from multiple diverse viewpoints to gain a holistic understanding and avoid bias

label: Political Optimization
description: Optimize communication and strategy to achieve consensus or specific goals within a political context
